_comment: FICTIONAL example for the made-up 'Lantern Library' app (same as journeys.example.json). This is the acceptance-v1 block an author puts in the PR body, fenced as ```acceptance-v1 ... ``` -- exactly one per PR. It documents the block shape and is the test fixture for smoke-acceptance.py; smoke-acceptance.test.sh freezes fictional request sources that contain each quote. Every quote must occur verbatim (whitespace-normalised) in the FROZEN request it names -- issue#<n> -> intent/issue-<n>.md, slack:<channel>/<thread> -> intent/slack-<channel>-<thread>.md, pr-body -> the PR body's prose with every acceptance-v1 fence stripped, so a quote that exists only inside this block is unsupported.

items.quote: a borrower with an overdue loan sees the fine on the borrower card before the librarian confirms a new loan
items.given: borrower QA-reader has one overdue loan with a fine
items.when: open the loan desk, pick QA-reader as the borrower

then.expect: the borrower card shows the fine amount; the confirm button is enabled

negative.given: the borrower has no overdue loan
negative.expect: no fine line renders on the card

items.quote: the fines list should refuse another branch's token with 403
items.when: GET /api/fines?branch=south with the north-branch seat's token

then.expect: 403 and no fine rows in the body

items.quote: the Loans tab shows the fine beside the overdue loan
items.when: open the Loans tab as QA-reader on the phone build

then.expect: the overdue loan row carries the fine amount
